clauses.exact_source_text: A food cooperative loans reusable delivery crates among three depots. Staff scan a crate label to see its inventory identity and record a receipt or return; a damaged label can be replaced. The cooperative wants readable printed identifiers even when a scanner is offline. Its legacy sheet records crate identity separately from each shipment. This research is about identifiers and scanning workflows, not payment or food-safety decisions.
clauses.assessment: RETAIN the cooperative pilot context and research boundaries. Investigated GS1/Snipe leads without choosing a winner; independently included Odoo and Sortly, not only the plan hints.

clauses.exact_source_text: The team has tentatively discussed GS1-oriented label workflows or Snipe-IT-style asset tracking. These are investigation leads, not selected winners. The mechanism needing investigation is barcode/QR identifiers, resolver URLs and reusable-asset identity; a useful historical inquiry concerns scanner parsing, identifier-format or resolver migration history. Do not let these leads prevent discovery of a better fit or an analogous mechanism.
clauses.assessment: RETAIN the cooperative pilot context and research boundaries. Investigated GS1/Snipe leads without choosing a winner; independently included Odoo and Sortly, not only the plan hints.
